description: Na₃SrCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.75 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.75 Å. Sr is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.82 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.30 Å) and two longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond lengths. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are three shorter (1.56 Å) and one longer (1.58 Å) P-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sr, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Sr, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃SrC trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sr, and one P atom to form corner-sharing ONa₂SrP tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sr, and one P atom.
